title: Datnie
role: UI/UX Design, Character & Animation, Unreal Visual Prototyping
description: A dating concept exploring lighter ways to browse, respond, and connect without constant typing.
challenge: Communicate both the product identity and its gesture-based interaction vocabulary.
solution: A music-led promotional film followed by a refined, interaction-focused Unity interface.
outcome: A cohesive product world spanning UI/UX, character development, animation, and real-time visual production.
